title: I'm making a game to defend Vietnam from the Third Mongol Invasion
author: Ok-Pirate5732
selftext:
# 100 BODIES IN THE GRASS



I'm making a co-op Hero defense set in Vietnam during the time of the **Third Mongol Invasion Dai Viet**. The full game will take you through different locations roughly following the course of the war, but Act I, which is shown in the trailer, is a wave-based defense of a northern Vietnamese village. 

Apart from a DLC expansion civ in AOE2, the Vietnamese in video games have traditionally only been represented by farmers with AKs that you get to blow up while listening to CCR (shoutout BF Vietnam). While fun, I'm hoping to change that! 



The name is inspired by a line from one of Vietnam's national resistance heroes, **Trần Hưng Đạo**, in a written vow to his officers before the invasion about how he would rather fight and die than submit to the Yuan dynasty:

*"Even if a hundred bodies of mine lie rotting in the wild grass, and a thousand of my corpses are wrapped in horsehide, I would still gladly do it."*

If you're interested in this period, I suggest you look up the full letter, it's quite interesting! 



**Features:** 

\- 4-player co-op

\- 4 unique heroes, each with their own customizable set of weapons and skill trees, defensive emplacements and traps

\- Procedurally generated village layouts and weather

\- An upgrade system that is tied directly to the village's structures

\- A village militia that can be upgraded and controlled 

  
**Tools:** 

Mostly Claude for coding (Opus), some Astra for visual assets, Elevenlabs for music. 3d asset workflow using Meshy. Animations 99%+ probably from free public asset libraries. I've found AI to be very, very bad for animations unless for very simple things, but even then at that point it's easier to do yourself. 



If this sounds interesting to you, [please feel free to wishlist us](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5357660/100_Bodies_in_the_Grass/) and follow our progress!
